title: App kind
description: A starting point for a common kind of finance app: what the studio offers on New app (its specific app ideas are rows in Postgres, app_ideas; see src/app-ideas.ts), what start_build accepts as kind, and what the coding agent reads (workspaces/coding-build/templates/kinds/<id>.json) and scaffolds (scripts/scaffold_app.py --kind <id>). Data only: the agent's instructions stay in the workspace's CLAUDE.md.

description.description: One line, shown under the title

product_lines.description: The product lines (PRODUCT_LINES in src/catalog.ts) whose products the app builds on: the studio filters products to these and picks from them

categories.description: Optional: the product categories in those lines the app is for (a product's category, such as deposits or retirement). The studio picks products in these categories; without it, any product in the lines

goal_template.description: The goal the user starts from and edits

screens.description: The screens to build first. scaffold_app.py lays each down as a placeholder (web/src/screens/, and mobile/app/ for Expo)

journey.description: This screen runs the product's journey with the starter's journey runner (web's App, mobile's index); at most one per kind

flows.description: The flows to build first, step by step

sdk_calls.description: The generated SDK's calls the app relies on: server ones from mynt-sdk (api/ only, with the app key), browser ones from mynt-sdk/browser (web/ and mobile/, on a client session)
